BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: BIOTECH   SESSION: SP/2020

SUBJECT: BT6025 FOOD AND ENZYME TECHNOLOGY

TIME: 1.5 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
6. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




Q1 (a) Write  the chemical  structure  of  any  four  amino  acids  and  indicate  is  basic  or  acidic
nature.
I. Alanine
II. Tryptophan
III. Glutamic acid
IV. Lysine
V. Tyrosine
[2]
 (b) What  do  you  understand  by  hydrogenation  of  lipids?  How  wax  is  useful  in  food
preservation?
[3]

Q2 (a) Draw the generalized texture profile of a homogenized food. Label the main components
in it.
[2]
 (b) Describe any four enzymes used in food industry. [3]

Q3 (a) What is the application of Affinity chromatography in enzyme purification? [2]
 (b) Draw a flowchart for isolation and purification of enzymes from bacterial cell. [3]

Q4 (a) Give a brief idea of Classification of Enzymes. Why enzymes need to be classified? [2]
 (b) What are the factors responsible for optimal enzyme activity? [3]

Q5 (a) Define the hurdle technology? [2]
 (b) What are the characteristic of food that are under consideration during food processing
and preservation?
[3]

Q6 (a) What is auto-oxidation of fatty acids? What is the ideal way for long term preservation
of fried snacks?
[2]
 (b) Give a comparative statement for Pasteurization and sterilization process. [3]

BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: BT   SESSION : SP/2019

SUBJECT : BT6025 FOOD & ENZYME TECHNOLOGY

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Select any two fat soluble vitamins and explain their role in our diet. [2]
 (b) Analyze the characteristics of proteins which affect food preparation. [3]


Q2 (a) Select, describe the features and role of any one food grade pigment. [2]
 (b) Distinguish between shear thinning and shear thickening food materials citing suitable
examples. What is Weissenberg effect?
[3]


Q3 (a) Categorize any two enzyme assay methods citing suitable examples. [2]
 (b) What are the features of Multienzyme complex? Explain with one suitable example. [3]


Q4 (a) Select  and  explain  any  two  methods  used  for  extraction  of  enzymes  from  microbial
sources.
[2]
 (b) Identify  the  uses  of  proteases  in  food  industry.  Give  examples  of  protease  producing
microorganisms.
[3]


Q5 (a) Select and describe the uses of any two chemical agents in food preservation. [2]
 (b) Categorize the role of high temperature in food preservation citing suitable examples. [3]


Q6 (a) Can you list the intrinsic factors which affect the growth of microbes in food? [2]
 (b) What is the relationship between modified atmospheres and food preservation? Explain
with suitable examples.
[3]
